t: You're looking at St Pancras Station and the former Midland Grand Hotel, a Grade I listed building. It was designed by George Gilbert Scott, a prolific English Gothic Revival architect. He is chiefly associated with churches and cathedrals, though he began his career designing workhouses. Over 800 buildings were designed or altered by him, and this is one of them. Take a moment to look at the building as a whole, and at how the Gothic style shapes it.
